    Coverage is reported, not guaranteed. Maps show what providers report to the FCC and the Wisconsin PSC. Call the provider to confirm service at your address before you buy or build.

    Cell coverage uses the FCC’s standards: 4G LTE at 5/1 Mbps and 5G at 7/1 Mbps. Internet is shown by FCC hexagon (about 0.3 sq mi), not by address, and speeds are each provider’s top advertised speed in town.

    Sources: FCC National Broadband Map (data as of ); PSC of Wisconsin electric service territories (approximate), refined with Bayfield Electric Cooperative’s line map (Oct 29, 2026); Vilas County 911 addresses; U.S. Census town boundary. Think a provider’s coverage is wrong? You can file a challenge on the FCC map.
